title: Mel-Khaonh Language (HKN) - L1 & L2 Speakers, Status, Map, Endangered ...
text: Mel-Khaonh is an endangered indigenous language of Cambodia. It belongs to the Austro-Asiatic language family. The language is used as a first language by all adults in the ethnic community, but not all young people. It is not known to be taught in schools.

title: Mel in Cambodia people group profile | Joshua Project
text: The Mel are more assimilated to the Khmer lifestyle than other more remote tribes. The new houses which are built in the Mel areas all reflect Khmer architecture and village layout, and most Mel children no longer speak Mel. There are numerous and large schools among the Mel villages as well as health centers and government offices.
